reasoning: The agent clearly exceeded the level-5 anchor: beyond reading run_tests and sampling every suite, it continually mined failing tests to infer concrete semantic requirements and probed ABI/assembly edge cases like alignment and page boundaries (level-8/10 behaviors), sustained across the whole trajectory. It falls short of 8-10 because it vendored an existing compiler (wrecc) and inherited most of the ABI/codegen contract rather than deriving it from small reference cases, and its orientation was largely reactive fix-driven rather than an anticipatory, self-built taxonomy of the target contract. This places the observed behavior at a 7, between the 5 and 8 anchors.
